subject: Evaluation kickoff & technical deep-dive scheduling
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Claire Hsu <claire.hsu@wellrise.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: evaluation kickoff + technical deep-dive

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Recap (what I heard)
- Primary goal: reduce average claim triage time by ~30% using extracted notes + reranking.
- Success signal: precision@5 on our triage prompts >= 75% and end-to-end latency < 350ms for 1–2 concurrent users.
- Data scope: de-identified notes for evaluation; live PII will not be used during trial.

Proposed next steps
1) Schedule a 30-min evaluation kickoff to walk the trial plan, success criteria, and deliverables (redwood-run eval with sample prompt set).
2) Schedule a separate 60-min technical deep-dive with your infra/ML lead to confirm network, auth, and example payloads.
3) Share our draft trial plan + success-criteria template (attached) so you can confirm or edit.

Availability (PST) — please pick any 2 options that work for you:
- Wed Apr 21: 10:00–10:30 OR 14:00–14:30
- Thu Apr 22: 09:00–09:30 OR 15:00–15:30

If none of the above work, share a 30-min window and we’ll adapt. I’m copying Ben Carter (technical lead) and Marissa Cole (onboarding ops) so they can join the appropriate sessions.

Attachments: trial_plan_draft.pdf, success_criteria_template.xlsx, integration_requirements.docx

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running for WellRise.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

- Phase 1 (week 0–1): small prompt set (20–30), basic throughput check, and success criteria baseline.
- Phase 2 (week 2–3): expanded prompt set (100), reranking evaluation, latency monitoring via Redwood Console.
- Deliverables: evaluation report, recommended quantization profile, and a short handoff doc for production readiness.

Prep request for the tech call (Tom/Claire):
- Example payloads (1–2 JSON records)
- Any VPC/firewall constraints or egress blockers
- A designated technical point-of-contact (Tom ok?)

Attachments: trial_plan_draft.pdf (updated), success_criteria_template.xlsx, integration_requirements.docx
